capabilities.complete_execution: One geometry candidate through the existing backend, fixed task evaluation and sampled holding/profile report. No search or additional local checks. Defer/reject leaves the execution allowance unused.

instructions: Read at least one prediction view and one motion or plans view. At most two successful reading turns; independent views can be batched. Then submit a concise initial report with 2-4 facts selected using fact_handles, competing hypotheses, explicit gaps and recommendations. Use the current fact_catalog; the host resolves selectors, report.source and recommendation configuration_scope. Recommendations may defer pending a check. Do not execute or select a numerical check in this phase. Availability gaps must use inventory IDs and not_displayed, not_read, queried, not_retained or retained_unavailable; identify needed information/capability and basis. Unlisted evidence uses source plus explicit basis. Full sampled backend q/qdot is retained, even though motion shows the final window. Raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions/scaling. Diagnose this baseline replay. Geometry recommendations can be described in recommended_actions; schema recommendations may use defer when no authorized change is justified. Controller weights are outside the physical grant. Availability status applies to the entire inventory entry unless you supply update_ids (controller updates) or time_range_s (sampled backend motion). For a partially read entry, use queried and describe missing coverage, or explicitly scope a not_read/not_displayed declaration to the unread subset.

capability_gaps: No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution tool. Full trajectories are not in every request.
Existing numerical checks use a projected GVS state and bounded horizon, not a full backend replay.
inventory.claim_policy: Use inventory plus your receipt ledger: not_displayed, not_read in this context, queried with stated coverage, not_retained, or retained_unavailable through a named capability. A sampled view or failed raw gzip read does not prove absence.

memory_policy.policy: Reconstruct system instructions plus structured state; no chronological conversation replay.
memory_policy.retention: Own accepted handoff products FIFO; oversized products retain reference only. Existing recent evidence pages and last four actions stay within their original host limits. Phase changes preserve these in the same context.
memory_policy.separation: single_context shares one memory across phases; dual_context keeps one per role and receives explicit current request/report/response/feedback handoffs.

request_content.question: Open diagnostic question about the baseline replay (execution_id 4e358bd36ab54be3afd5003f36ff8110; controller.gvs_nmpc 7.0.0; controller.parameters.data.numerical_source=bundled_guess): Why does a passing terminal reach coexist with a failing sampled holding on the same run, and how do the computation and plan-selection records relate to the failure? Specifically: reach_passed=true with terminal_error_m 0.00764 m below reach_tolerance_m 0.01 m and terminal_speed_m_s 0.635 m/s, versus sampled_settling_passed=false with late_max_error_m 0.0581 m above the position_limit_m 0.01 m and late_max_speed_m_s 1.581 m/s above the speed_limit_m_s 0.02 m/s across the 0.05 s window. How do the reported computation figures (mean_update_s 17.30 s against control_period_s 0.01 s, deadline_misses 35, stopping_counts User_Requested_Stop 34 versus Solve_Succeeded 1, max_cpu_s 30.0) and the per-update plan_selection (initialization_selected 29, noninitialization_selected 6, one Solve_Succeeded), solver_status, and effective_horizon records bear on when the tip position/speed stopped decreasing inside the holding window? Treat this as an open inventory-and-summary investigation: do not assume the baseline passed, and do not assert a dominant cause from a single execution.
scope: retained-evidence reads: read-only inspection of the baseline inventory entries and common summary already handed over (one_step_predictions, applied_tensions, saved_projected_states, plan_selection, solver_status, controller_horizon, force_limits) and the sampled backend motion/prediction views via evidence.read; observations reported, not causal claims.
no saved-state numerical work authorized in this pilot: neither prediction_braking nor local_comparison is requested, and no single-check numerical grant is sought here.

excluded: production/configuration changes and backend execution; closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution (named capability gap); historical full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces (source.historical_full_plans not retained).
stopping_conditions: Stop once retained-evidence reads, with stated query coverage, have characterized the terminal reach observation, the sampled holding position/speed observation, and the computation/timing observations for this execution.

Stop and report as not computable with current tools if answering requires saved-state numerical checks, backend execution, closed-loop counterfactual replay, or the unretained historical full plans/optimizer traces.

State queried coverage and any not_read subset explicitly; do not infer absence from a sample or from a failed raw read, and do not attribute a dominant cause from a single execution or from model comparisons.
